entry.title: Roter Sand
entry.note: Exact-identity OSM node 635484478 agrees within 0.1 m with the 2019 engineering report WGS84 coordinate 53°51′11.4″ N / 8°04′55.81″ E; the older DSD 2010 and candidate coordinates are about 207 m north. Survey compass directions fix bay orientation. GMG III-9 places historic low water at NN -2.05 m; sea-level preview assumes the viewer zero approximates NN, with tidal/water-datum review pending. Owner’s 2026 chronology describes a future relocation, not a completed move. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
